semiconductor_relevance: High — SRT Co., Ltd. specializes in non-destructive testing equipment and automated inspection machines specifically designed for the semiconductor industry.
summary: SRT Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures advanced non-destructive testing equipment and automated inspection systems for the semiconductor and electronic components sectors. Their flagship product, the VSA M350, utilizes ultrasonic imaging technology to detect internal defects, supporting quality control and research applications.

regional_presence.Japan: SRT Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Tsuchiura City, Japan, focusing on the domestic semiconductor market.
